seo.title: Carrd vs Strikingly — Best Choice for Landing Pages or Simple Sit
seo.meta_description: Compare Carrd and Strikingly: which website builder fits your needs? See differences in ease, pricing, templates, ecommerce, and which tool converts better for

hero.headline: Carrd vs Strikingly
hero.subheadline: A side-by-side comparison for buyers, operators, and affiliate-content readers.

summary.best_for_a: Carrd is best for people who want ultra-fast, affordable one-page sites and landing pages with minimal setup.
summary.best_for_b: Strikingly is best for users who need an easy path to a multi-section site with built-in blogging and simple ecommerce.
summary.quick_take: If you need a focused, lightning-fast single-page site or landing page that’s inexpensive and easy to maintain, Carrd is the lean, no-friction choice. If you expect to grow into a larger presence with multiple pages, simple stores, and more built-in site features, Strikingly gives you more structure out of the box — at a slightly higher cost and with more templates and e-commerce convenience.

paragraphs: Carrd and Strikingly both promise fast, approachable website building with minimal technical overhead, but they aim at slightly different goals. Carrd focuses on single-page sites and landing pages with a tiny footprint and very low cost. Strikingly offers a guided experience for a fuller site with extra features like blogging and basic ecommerce.

This comparison highlights where each tool shines — from templates and customization to pricing, integrations, and where you might hit limits — so you can pick the one that helps you convert visitors fastest for your specific use case.

data.headline: Choose Carrd for lean landing pages; pick Strikingly for growth-ready simple sites
data.summary: Carrd wins when speed, price, and simplicity matter. Strikingly wins when you need multi-section pages, built-in blogging, or simple ecommerce without a steep learning curve.

items.question: Can I sell products on Carrd or Strikingly?
items.answer: Strikingly includes built-in basic ecommerce for small catalogs and digital goods; Carrd can accept payments via embeds or third-party checkout tools but lacks native store management.

items.question: Which is better for landing pages and single-page promos?
items.answer: Carrd is optimized for single-page landing pages, with faster setup, lower cost, and lightweight pages that convert well for simple campaigns.

items.question: Can I use a custom domain and email with either platform?
items.answer: Both platforms support custom domains on paid plans; email hosting is handled separately through third-party providers.

items.question: Is SEO possible on one-page Carrd sites?
items.answer: Yes — Carrd offers basic SEO controls (titles, descriptions, meta tags) suitable for single-page optimization, though multi-page sites typically provide more SEO opportunities.

items.question: Which platform scales better as my site grows?
items.answer: Strikingly scales more naturally for adding pages, a blog, and simple store features; Carrd remains ideal if you keep your presence single-page and minimal.
